source: Abou El-Hamd et al. (2023), Buildings 13, 824, Figure 19, reproducing the M6 joint law of Abou El-Hamd et al. (2018), Thin-Walled Structures 125, 140-151
thickness_rule: At fixed bolt torque, retain the friction and clearance force levels; scale the increments of bearing resistance above the clearance plateau by strip thickness. This is the reduced model assumption, not a measured double-thickness joint law.
